content.title: Four things we would tell you before you build this

items.title: Never let the image model render a number
items.text: Plausible-looking wrong data is worse than obviously wrong data, because it ships.

items.title: Templates beat freeform layout
items.text: Constraining the model to archetypes is what makes output consistently on-brand.

items.title: Supersample, then downsample
items.text: Rendering at 2x and resampling with Lanczos is the cheapest quality win available.

items.title: Cache the generative step
items.text: A background costs 80 seconds once, and nothing every time after that.
